blocks.title: Enthalpy change of reaction
blocks.text: Reaction ki standard enthalpy woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab reactants apni standard states mein, stoichiometric (equation mein likhi hui) miqdar mein, standard conditions par poori tarah react kar ke products banayein.
Misal ke taur par hydrogen aur oxygen gases ka reaction jis se 1 mole pani banta hai:

blocks.text_alt: H₂(g) + ½ O₂(g) → H₂O(l)    ΔHr = –286 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt: Agar pani banne ki equation ko double kar ke 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O likhen to ΔHr kitna hoga, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: –572 kJ. Reaction ki enthalpy change equation mein likhi miqdar ke liye hoti hai; miqdar double karein to heat bhi double ho jati hai.

items: ΔHr: standard conditions par equation ki miqdar mein reactants ke poori tarah react karne ki enthalpy change; H₂ + ½O₂ → H₂O(l), –286 kJ mol⁻¹.
